provenance.basis_summary: Fraud-hold policy 3.2 adopted with a measured 1.4% false-positive rate on the Q4 backtest; reversal path rehearsed in February.

populations: retail accounts, excluding accounts flagged vulnerable

for_whom: Retail banking customers, on behalf of the Fraud Operations desk

evidence_basis.summary: Hold rules and thresholds for suspected account takeover.
Q1 backtest: 1.4% false-positive rate, median release 31 hours.

assumptions: False-positive hold rate stays below 2% on the rolling 30-day window.
The Risk Steward can release any hold within two hours of a challenge.
Vulnerable-account flags are current within 24 hours.
review_conditions: False-positive hold rate exceeds 2% on the rolling 30-day window.
Any challenge decided against the system.
Policy POL-FRAUD-HOLD-3.2 enters review_required or expires.
revocation_conditions: Holds placed on accounts flagged vulnerable.
Intervention reach time exceeds four hours in any incident.

state_history.note: Challenge opened by an affected party over a hold on a recently flagged vulnerable account.
Narrowed: populations now exclude accounts flagged vulnerable; max_hold_days reduced from 14 to 7.

renewal_basis: A fresh backtest on the preceding quarter, the current dependency record, and a withdrawal rehearsal within the last 90 days.
